title: Check ruling: delegates in behavioral fixtures answer, so a dispatch is never a fixture failure
situation: In the architect's behavioral fixtures a delegate the architect dispatches cannot start (no model selected), so its failure is reported in the architect's reply and fails ordering clauses of workflow 23, agents 18 and held-out agents 4 for a reason that is the fixture's, not the architect's.
decision: Yes. In a behavioral fixture, a delegate the subject dispatches is routed to a stand-in that accepts the assignment and returns a fixed acknowledgement in the design's terms; whether and how the subject dispatches stays judged as before. No clause, rubric, threshold or example text changes; the rebound check is seen to fail against a subject whose report carries a delegate's failure as its own topic.
consequences: Runs failed only by a delegate that could not start are re-run under the rebound fixture, as not yet run.
